details.summary: Show the two ideas
details.text: Show the two ideasThe daemon's worker retains workspace discovery, backend objects, and reusable preparation, while refreshing the requested view and renewing semantic query caches after success. Once accepted, a request belongs to the daemon's ledger. Fetching stored output or reattaching to that identity recovers delivery without a second execution turn; unrecoverable accepted work returns a controlled failure.
